restoration_note: The teaching catalogues the technical names of the garments (great garments, pearls/clusters, icons, robes-of-work, element-of-light, cross-of-light, counsel-of-life, soul-afflicted) and explains them as one reality — the rational in its five degrees, the Lord's operative power, the three accommodations of the Living Spirit, the truth standing in everything below, the soul stretched in the contest, the divine summons, and the soul borne under affliction — all of which are one substance from the beginning that gathers back into one likeness/name at consummation. Most gaps are line-split morphology (Omophoros, ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ, ϯⲟ̄ⲁⲙ, ⲍⲗⲍⲁⲗⲧ, ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ) restored with high confidence. Lexicon-driven choices (Ⲛⲥⲧⲟⲓⲭⲉⲓⲟⲛ, ⲡⲱⲙⲟⲫⲟⲣⲟⲥ, ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ, ϯⲟ̄ⲁⲙ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ) anchor the technical terminology. The damaged closing (4397–4399) and gap 44 left unrestorable: too short and unconstrained.
